subject: archetype-long-table-host
_note: SYNTHETIC Gold insight pack for the demo: a fan of the example creator @wishbonekitchen (cooking, dinner parties, lifestyle). Built by recombining traits from existing Gold archetypes (see archetype.borrowed_from). Not a person. Palette and shares are example values.

archetype.name: Long-Table Host
archetype.one_line: Cooks for a crowd and turns an ordinary week night into a dinner party.

reads.rhythms: The week is quiet and the energy is saved for one long night: market in the morning, cooking all afternoon, a full table after dark that runs late.
reads.life_phases: Every new place becomes the venue first; the table, the good plates and the people come before the rest of the flat is unpacked.

title_phrasings: Cooks for twelve without being asked
Gets a second wind when the room fills
Shops the market before planning the menu
Saves the week's energy for one long dinner
Sets the table before anything else
archetype.social: big groups over one-to-one: the table is full, rarely a table for two

borrowed_from.small-table-host: cooks the occasion themselves; candlelight; handmade touches (scaled up from four to a crowd)
borrowed_from.two-gear-day: gets a second wind when the room fills; the night goes to company and volume
borrowed_from.same-order-regular: saves the week's energy for one big night
borrowed_from.first-light-solitary: up early, but for the market rather than the trail
